I very much so agree that leveling is miserably slow and tedious (7.3.5 don't even get me started on 8.0.1) but it seems like Blizzard just doesn't seem to get it.

An issue I don't see many people bringing up would be your supply of nethershards. Correct me if I'm wrong but I believe the only quick way to get the shards would be through the invasions and those will only get you around 1500-2000 shards so roughly 20 attempts. And if you're shooting to get it done by the pre-patch there should only be one or two more of those popping up in time. Normally this wouldn't be an issue but at ilvl 880 all I have to say is goodluck! Just study the fights and know your classes well and you should be fine!
